text: If you've tried to talk yourself out of a trigger and couldn't, that's because anatomy overrides intellect. Dr. Perry describes a "Metabolic Red Line" for the traumatized brain: once your resting heart rate goes up or your heart-rate variability drops (a state of "Fear"), blood flow shifts away from the Cortex, which does logic and reasoning, and down to the Brainstem, which runs survival.
reader: someone with trauma who gets triggered and tries to think their way out of it, wanting to know why that fails and when to do trauma work

sentences.s: If you've tried to talk yourself out of a trigger and couldn't, that's because anatomy overrides intellect.
sentences.payoff: they recognize their own failed attempts and learn it is anatomy, not a failing of theirs
sentences.follows: opens section A under its heading with the reader's own experience of a trigger
